items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: when you used to play with George Garner, you, Howard and Alec Big Art

ctx.x: Well I mean I heard it, yeah, it would have been 15, 20 years later. No, it wouldn't. This number, Victory, when these fellas put on the record and called it the second line, we used to play that number I would say about at least a half an hour. But I used to walk the ball all around the tables and everything, and while the band was still playing. And that was one of our most famous numbers down there, you know, what we made plenty of money on.

Let me ask you something, Lionel. When you first had the band there, when you used to play with George Garner, you, Howard and Alec Big Art, and then since we came back there, I don't know, it must have been 10 years later, aren't it, Howard? Years there. Yeah, 10 or 15 years later. We took the same four pieces there. Do you think the music on the records you made sounded much like the music you used to play there? I think so. Do you think there was any difference at all? I mean.
No, I wouldn't say that. I wouldn't say that.
